briefdescription.para: Output stream manipulator for ending a line in test reports.

detaileddescription.para: Calls reporter::end_line(), which appends a line ending to the internal buffer. Unlike std::endl, it does not flush; the buffer is written later, by the concrete reporters.

stream
Reference to the reporter instance.
Reference to the same reporter instance, enabling chaining of output operations.
The endl function calls reporter::end_line(), which appends a newline character to the buffer of the specified reporter.

briefdescription.para: C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ test reporter.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the declarations for the test reporting facilities used within the µTest++ framework. It defines the endl and indent() stream manipulators, and the abstract reporter base class, which accumulates output in a buffer, writes it to the console and to an optional output file, and dispatches the pass/fail results and the session, suite, and test case events to the concrete reporters (reporter_human and reporter_tap).
The formatting of the values and the comparison expressions is delegated to detail::expression_formatter.

The verbosity levels, and the other session options, are defined in runner-options.h. The manipulators and the reporter are defined in the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail namespace, since the reporters are internal to the framework.
The header files are organised within the include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
